jobs.title: Security Officer – Corporate Lobby Desk
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer – Corporate Lobby Desk in Chicago, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. As a Front Desk Officer at a commercial real estate location, you will welcome tenants and visitors, support lobby operations, monitor entry points and cameras, manage visitor logs and badges, and respond to alarms and security-related concerns with clear communication. You will represent Allied Universal with a people-first approach, staying agile and reliable while partnering with the site team to help maintain an orderly, professional environment.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $23.50 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon07:00 AM – 03:00 PMTue07:00 AM – 03:00 PMWed07:00 AM – 03:00 PMSat07:00 AM – 03:00 PMSun07:00 AM – 03:00 PM

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, and vendors at the front desk by following Allied Universal security-related procedures and site-specific policies.
  • Control access to the property by greeting and directing guests, verifying identification and/or credentials, issuing visitor passes, and maintaining visitor logs.
  • Monitor and acknowledge alarms, cameras, and other building systems from the front desk, and report irregular activity according to post orders.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, including contacting emergency services and/or property management as directed.
  • Complete required documentation such as incident reports, access logs, and shift activity reports, and communicate pertinent information during shift turnovers.

Minimum Requirements

  • Client requires proof of high school diploma and/or GED.
  • Alarm panel experience is preferred.
  • Access control and/or badge experience is preferred.
  • CPR certification is preferred.A guard card and/or license is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

jobs.title: Corporate Security Protection Officer
jobs.description:
Location: Chicago, IL (downtown)

Schedule: Onsite | Full-Time

Position Summary

Our client, a leading financial services organization, is seeking a Corporate Security Protection Officer to provide a visible security presence and ensure the safety of employees, clients, and visitors within a corporate banking environment. This is a professional, client-facing position requiring strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to respond effectively to dynamic situations while maintaining a polished appearance and professional demeanor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a visible security presence throughout corporate banking facilities.
  • Conduct routine patrols of offices, common areas, and secured locations.
  • Monitor access points and address unauthorized access, tailgating, or security violations.
  • Assess potential threats and respond appropriately to safety and security incidents.
  • Serve as a point of contact for employees, clients, guests, and visitors regarding security concerns.
  • Investigate suspicious activity and escalate incidents as necessary.
  • Support emergency response procedures and maintain situational awareness at all times.
  • Provide a reassuring and professional presence while helping deter disruptive behavior.
  • Ensure compliance with company security policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Must possess and maintain a personally owned firearm and be able to legally carry and conceal while on duty.
  • Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to remain alert, mobile, and actively patrol throughout the workday.
  • Professional appearance and ability to work in a business attire environment.

Schedule

  • 8-hour shifts with rotating schedules
  • Shift rotation occurs approximately every 4 weeks

Typical shift options include:

  • 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
  • 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM
  • No weekends
  • No holidays
  • Overtime available and paid when required

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Paid Time Off, and additional employee benefit offerings available.

If interested in more details, please apply!

Salary: USD 60000 - 80000 per year

jobs.title: Field Supervisor (Overnight) (P4S - Corporate)
jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview


Join P4 Companies — including P4 Security Solutions and P4 Protective Services — leaders in professional security services. We offer flexible opportunities for both security professionals and law enforcement officers across multiple industries. We are looking for individuals who bring vigilance, integrity, and professionalism, and who take pride in being a visible, reassuring presence. If you value teamwork and want a career with growth potential in the security field, P4 Companies may be the right fit for you.

Opportunities for Security Officers
Provide security at commercial buildings, residential communities, manufacturing sites, retail, campuses, cannabis facilities, and events. Key duties include:

  • Customer service and access control

  • Patrols and incident response

  • Site monitoring and safety enforcement

  • Ideal for individuals seeking stability, teamwork, and career growth in security.

Opportunities for Active or Retired Law Enforcement
Specialized assignments throughout Illinois, including executive protection, patrol programs, healthcare, campuses, private venues, and retail.

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Competitive rates statewide

  • Perfect for officers seeking supplemental income or flexible off-duty work.

Officers bring their advanced training, professionalism, and command presence to ensure safety in high-trust environments. Your experience makes a difference, and Security Solutions values your service and leadership. Whether you are beginning your security career or leveraging decades of law enforcement experience, The Companies provide a path for meaningful and rewarding work. Join us in making safety and service a priority.

Job Skills / Requirements

Schedule: 11:00 PM-7:00 AM (40hrs per week)

Job Overview:

The Overnight Field Supervisor enforces adherence to post orders and regulatory requirements across assigned locations. This role conducts routine site inspections, evaluates officer performance, and responds to incidents. Serving as a liaison between corporate and field personnel, the Supervisor provides support and ensures consistent application of security protocols. The position requires strong decision-making, effective communication, detailed reporting, ability to work alone with minimal supervision, and the ability to manage high-pressure situations with professionalism and integrity.

*For current employees, you must be actively employed for a minimum of six months.*

Key Responsibilities

1. Site & Officer Oversight

  • Conduct routine inspections across assigned client locations.
  • Ensure Security Officers (SO) and Off-Duty Police Officers (ODP) are:
    • Present on site
    • In proper uniform and equipped appropriately
    • Following all site-specific post orders
  • Inspect and document the condition of vehicles used in the field.
  • Confirm up-to-date licensing, training, and compliance for all personnel.

2. Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Identify and address security vulnerabilities, safety violations, or procedural non-compliance.
  • Enforce company policies and site-specific standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Conduct field compliance audits.
  • Maintain thorough logs, reports, and digital documentation.
  • Provide timely and accurate reporting through approved platforms.

3. Incident Response & Field Communications

  • Respond swiftly to critical incidents or emergencies within assigned territory.
  • Remain on-site during escalations until resolution or proper handoff.
  • Serve as the communication bridge between field staff, SOC, and management.
  • Document all incident activity with complete and clear reporting.

4. Administrative & Operational Support

  • Complete all required certifications and administrative tasks on schedule.
  • Report equipment, vehicle, or operational issues promptly.
  • Represent the company professionally, discreetly, and with a client-focused approach.
  • Serve as a backup for security officers during emergencies or shortages.
  • Assist with vehicle movements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Skills & Competencies

  • 2 years of security experience preferred
  • Strong leadership presence with high emotional intelligence
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient with security reporting systems
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable in dynamic environments
  • Comfortable enforcing rules, providing feedback, and handling confrontational situations professionally; de-escalation skills a plus
  • Ability to work independently

Technology & Tools

  • Mobile inspection/reporting platforms
  • Two-way radios and mobile devices
  • GPS operation
  • After 6 months on the job, employees will begin the process to become armed and obtain the necessary credentials and licensing to carry a firearm while on duty.

Minimum Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • At least 21 years of age
  • Valid Driver’s License in good standing
  • Valid FOID Card (Firearm Owner’s Identification)
  • Valid and active PERC Card (Permanent Employee Registration Card)
  • Fingerprint background check with “Eligible” status via ISP
  • 7-year criminal background clearance and drug screening
  • Reliable personal transportation
  • Ability to write clear, professional, and grammatically correct reports
  • Ability to pass MVR screening

Education Requirements (All)

GED or High School Diploma

Certification Requirements (All)

PERC Card
20 hour Security Training Certificate

Additional Information /...

jobs.title: Air Logistics Warehouse Associate - Shipping & Receiving
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

(Official Position: Air Logistics Warehouse Specialist)

Join Kuehne+Nagel's QuickSTAT team in Schiller Park, IL, where you'll help ensure time-critical consignments move safely and efficiently through our warehouse. This onsite opportunity offers a starting pay of $23.00 per hour and the chance to work in a fast-paced, quality-driven logistics environment.

How you create impact

As a Warehouse Associate, you will help ensure time-critical consignments and inventory move through the QuickSTAT warehouse safely, accurately, and efficiently. You will complete Goods In and Goods Out processes, prepare specialized temperature-controlled packaging solutions, and maintain the detailed documentation and quality standards required in a compliance-driven environment. In this role, you will:

  • Process incoming consignments and inventory through the Goods In process, including documentation review, product inspection, piece counts, weights, dimensions, damage checks, and system updates
  • Complete Goods Out processing for outbound shipments, ensuring documentation, shipment details, packaging, and required re-icing are accurate
  • Select and prepare temperature-controlled packaging solutions, including PCM, liquid nitrogen, and dry ice, based on shipment requirements
  • Select and prepare temperature loggers and GPS tracking devices from onsite inventory
  • Perform and document quality checks on reusable temperature-controlled packaging
  • Clean, restock, organize, and update reusable packaging inventory within the warehouse system
  • Load and unload vehicles manually and with onsite forklift equipment
  • Prepare consolidated consignments for transfer to other QuickSTAT facilities
  • Enter key shipment milestones and maintain accurate inventory and shipping records
  • Monitor the departmental mailbox for packaging bookings, shipment updates, and internal operational requests
  • Respond to telephone and email inquiries from internal and external departments accurately and efficiently
  • Identify and clearly communicate shipment discrepancies, inventory issues, and potential operational delays
  • Maintain warehouse hygiene, organization, safety, and compliance standards
  • Provide clear shift reports and handovers to ensure continuity between warehouse teams

What we would like you to bring

You are dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a hands-on warehouse environment where accurate documentation and careful handling are essential. You can manage assigned responsibilities independently after training while communicating effectively and contributing to a collaborative team. To be successful in this role, you should bring:

  • Previous experience in warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, inventory control, freight, transportation, or logistics
  • Familiarity with Goods In and Goods Out, inbound receiving, outbound shipping, or similar warehouse processes
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to complete manual and electronic documentation accurately
  • Experience working in a safety-focused, quality-controlled, or compliance-driven environment
  • Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize assigned work, and meet strict deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort managing operational email communication
  • Ability to work independently after training while supporting the broader warehouse team
  • Reliable attendance, punctuality, and a consistent approach to completing assigned work
  • Experience handling temperature-controlled, time-critical, life sciences, or specialized freight is preferred
  • Familiarity with cold chain packaging solutions, GDP requirements, or courier and freight operations is a plus
  • Computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and warehouse or inventory systems
  • Ability to work in a physically active, non-climate-controlled warehouse environment and safely lift up to 49 pounds, with team-lift or equipment support available for heavier items

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. We offer a dynamic global work environment with opportunities for excellent training programs and career mobility. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, skills, job location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Kuehne+Nagel reviews pay ranges regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay based on industry market data. TD1

Kuehne+Nagel participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in specific processes [e.g. screening applications, interview scheduling]. These tools analyze information to support decision-making, but final decisions are made by human reviewers.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

Kuehne+Nagel is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) and to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful retaliation. Kuehne+Nagel strictly prohibits all discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, religious creed or belief, physical or mental disability, marital or familial status, legally protected medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), gender (including gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, citizenship status, protected activity (such as opposition to or reporting of prohibited discrimination or harassment. Kuehne+Nagel will also make reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees, including accommodations for pregnancy and childbirth, and for the sincerely held religious beliefs of applicants and employees depending upon individual circumstances unless such accommodation would create an undue hardship on Kuehne+Nagel.

jobs.description:
Wise Staffing Group is NOW HIRING multiple Warehouse Associates in the West Chicago, IL area! Multiple shifts available!


Job Summary:

We are seeking a Warehouse Associate to join a fast-paced warehouse and distribution operation. This position supports inventory management, shipping, receiving, and order fulfillment. This role is responsible for performing hands-on warehouse duties, including picking, packing, sorting, material handling, and inventory activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities as needed.
  • Load, unload, move, and organize materials throughout the warehouse.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and warehouse operating guidelines.
  • Perform a combination of equipment operation and manual warehouse tasks throughout the shift.


Qualifications:

  • Previous warehouse experience required.
  • Cherry picker experience preferred.
  • Ability to lift, carry, move, and handle materials throughout the shift.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Ability to perform repetitive physical tasks while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.
  • Reliable attendance and dependable work ethic.


Why Wise Staffing Group:

  • Temp-to-hire opportunity


Benefits:

Headquartered in Tupelo, MS, Wise Staffing Group is a full-service human resources company specializing in temporary and career staffing with an emphasis on providing excellent customer service. We have developed and offer industry leading services that provide dependable, qualified workers. Each office sets and maintains the same high standards of operation and ongoing commitment to quality services. We consistently work toward superior performance in fulfilling client needs.

jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.description:
Have you ever enjoyed Arnold®, Brownberry® or Oroweat® bread? A Thomas’® English muffin or bagel? Or perhaps snacked on a Sara Lee®, Entenmann’s® or Marinela® cake or donut? If the answer is yes, then you know Bimbo Bakeries USA!

More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.

Let’s Bake – Help Us Make America’s Favorite Baked Goods - Entenmann’s

Forklift Operator

The Forklift Driver is an entry level position within our distribution department at our bakeries. They are responsible for the front-line distribution operations that perform various duties including moving stacks of product, using pick to light programs or voice activated equipment, filling orders, loading and unloading trucks, etc.

Top Reasons To Work At Bimbo Bakeries USA

  • $24.30 per hour.
  • Full benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Plan .
  • 2nd Shift Opening (Start Time: 5pm).

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Take appropriate action to ensure the integrity and sustained certification of the food safety and food quality system.
  • Responsible for reporting and taking any necessary action to prevent food safety and food quality problems from occurring.
  • Responsible for following and enforcing procedures outlined in the Food Safety Plan and the Food Quality Plan and any other programs that support the SQF system and other 3rd party audits.
  • Load trucks and routes with proper amount of each variety.
  • Have knowledge of where products are located on shipping dock.
  • Have knowledge of how much of each variety is in each tray.
  • Keep empty trays available for wrapping personnel.
  • Unload product and/ or empty trays from incoming transports.
  • Keep the work area clean.
  • Perform any other job-related duties assigned to them by their supervisor or lead person.
  • Regular dependable attendance is an essential function of this position.
  • Requires lifting, bending, twisting, stooping, excessive walking and constant standing.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What we need from you: 

  • High School Diploma/GED/Equivalent Preferred.
  • 1-3 years of shipping or warehouse experience preferred.
  • Ability to operate a forklift.
  • Ability to use a hand truck, two-wheel dolly, or other equipment to move product.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and must also adapt to frequent changes that occur on the production line.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, stack and/or carry trays, push/pull stacks of product, etc.
  • Must be able to work around various food machinery equipment.
  • Basic math skills.
  • Ability to stand and/or stoop for the full shift (typically 12 hours).
  • Ability to work in a loud, hot work environment.
  • Willing to work irregular and/or rotating shifts, including split days off (non-consecutive days off).
  • Ability to work holidays and weekends. Must be at least 18 years of age.

The physical and mental demands described in each job posting are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of each job. Reasonable accommodations may be requested to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of each job.

Bimbo Bakeries USA is an equal opportunity employer with a policy that provides equal employment opportunity for applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, any other classification protected by law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
